notes:
- Form fields are now tinted (Acrobat-style mauve by default) so it's easy to
  see where you can type. Choose a different colour — or turn it off — in the
  new Settings panel.
- New page background option for viewing comfort: soften the white page to a
  soft, sepia or grey tone. Display only — saved and printed PDFs stay
  exactly as they were.
- New Settings panel (gear icon in the toolbar): field highlight colour, page
  background, and automatic update checks.
- Court forms and other Reader-extended PDFs (such as the UK N244) no longer
  show an "extended features are no longer available" error in Adobe Acrobat
  after saving from Tumbler.
